content: GitHub REST best practices: conditional requests (ETag/If-None-Match) are for GET; 'Conditional requests for unsafe methods, such as POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE are not supported' unless endpoint docs say otherwise. No If-Match on issue comment PATCH. Make requests serially; wait >=1s between mutative requests to avoid secondary rate limits. => ledger concurrency needs app-level re-read/compare + writer-owned sections + verify-after-write.
